content: sourcegraph/go-diff: ParseMultiFileDiff(diff []byte) returns []*FileDiff with error. FileDiff has OrigName, NewName, Hunks []*Hunk. Hunk has Body []byte containing lines with +/-/space prefixes. ParseFileDiff for single file. v0.6.0+ uses plain Go structs (no protobuf). Handles rename/binary file headers. ErrBadHunkHeader/ErrBadHunkLine for error detection. Alternative: port the Python unidiff-backed parser directly since the 12 edge-case fixture corpus is already known.
